programs.description: A poor widow works tirelessly to give her son a good life and education. However, the boy's grandfather, who once refused to accept them, suddenly reappears and offers to adopt him.
A comprehensive compilation of some of the best devotional songs by various artists in praise of the various gods and goddesses.
A subject-matter expert conducts an informative lecture on songs composed by Rabindranath Tagore with suitable examples in a detailed and easy-to-understand manner.
Sukanta is shattered when his wife, Minu, is raped on their honeymoon. Though his wife fails to recognise him after the incident, her twin sister, Debu, tries to find the culprit.
Gopal Bhar is appointed as a jester in Raja Krishnachandra's court in medieval Bengal. His wit and humour are well-known in the region and his exploits always have a significant social message.
